title: Late bike delivery
ask: Morning. Priya Nair wrote in overnight about her order HC-4417 from Harbour Cycles, which is three days late. Her message is in inbox/customer.txt. Please write the reply and send it to her from the shop account.
background: For context, the courier lost a day at the depot and the bike is now due on Thursday 5 March.
She has ordered from us twice before and was polite about it, so I'd like to keep her.
I'm in the workshop all morning and won't see messages until lunch.

constraints.text: if you offer a credit, nothing over $25, and do put a dollar figure on it
open with "Hi Priya," on its own line
use the exact words "new delivery date"

start.inbox/customer.txt:
From: priya.nair@customer.example
Subject: Order HC-4417

Hi, my bike was due on Monday and the tracking page has not moved. Can you tell me when it will arrive?

Priya
